_scope: One declaration for every fact that Tier 3 marks Assumed. A declaration turns an Unresolved or unevidenced fact into a conscious Assumed (§12.2) owned and dated by the operator; it never makes a fact Confirmed. Every Assumed record in Tier 3 names its declaration_key here, and every key below backs at least one such record. The file carries two kinds of declaration: most relay something the operator knows or has decided and cannot yet evidence in partner writing; the keys listed in _operator_placeholders stand in for something nobody has supplied.
